english.note: This is the all-purpose word for a man working behind a bar; Cantonese normally leaves the male gender implicit.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who tends a bar and serves drinks.
Use 酒保 for the barman serving or drawing drinks from a bar tap.

examples.english: The barman at that bar is very good at looking after customers.
examples.traditional: 嗰間酒吧個酒保好識招呼客人。
examples.jyutping: go2 gaan1 zau2 baa1 go3 zau2 bou2 hou2 sik1 ziu1 fu1 haak3 jan4

examples.english: The bartender at that bar is very good at looking after customers.
examples.traditional: 嗰間酒吧嘅酒保好識招呼客人。
examples.jyutping: go2 gaan1 zau2 baa1 ge3 zau2 bou2 hou2 sik1 ziu1 fu1 haak3 jan4

examples.english: The drawer draws beer for customers.
